title: Publish an output file to the user with Connector.Publish and find the run's script and log in the audit trail
task: Get a file the script wrote (a report, an export) into the user's hands: write it, call Connector.Publish(path, name), read the per-file status in the response's files[]; an existing name fails that file unless execute_script overwrite_output_files is true. Every run also leaves its script under scripts/ and an NDJSON log under logs/ beside Connector.ExportsDirectory.

pitfalls.symptom: files[] shows status failed with a message naming overwrite_output_files; the run itself succeeded.
pitfalls.cause: Publish's copy path refuses to overwrite an existing name in exports/ by default; per-file failures never abort the run.
pitfalls.fix: Use a new name, or pass overwrite_output_files: true when replacing is intended.

pitfalls.symptom: Publish reported published although the name existed and no flag was passed.
pitfalls.cause: The file was written directly into ExportsDirectory, so Publish registered it in place (no copy, no gate).
pitfalls.fix: Expected; the gate governs Publish's own copy only.

pitfalls.symptom: The published path is not visible from the agent's machine.
pitfalls.cause: The workspace is on the machine running Revit; in remote mode that is not the agent's host, and there is no file-transfer tool: files move through the filesystem (skill.md "Exchanging files").
pitfalls.fix: Report the path from files[] to the user; in remote mode they reach it through the shared folder the workspace sits on.
